description: This Rust source file defines functions to build a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with Google APIs based on a discovery document. It constructs commands and subcommands for resources and methods, including handling of arguments and pagination, and includes unit tests for command structure validation.

methods.name: build_cli
methods.description: Constructs the root CLI command with global arguments and resource subcommands based on a discovery document.

methods.name: build_resource_command
methods.description: Recursively builds CLI commands for a resource, including methods and nested sub-resources.
